sentences.text:
Appearance:
 Shri Sunil Kumar Dubey - Advocate for the applicant.
 Shri Samar Ghuraiya - PP for the respondents/State.
Learned counsel for the rival parties are heard.
The applicant has filed this fourth repeat bail application u/S 439 of Cr.P.C/Section 483 of BNSS for grant of bail.

The applicant has been arrested on 10.04.2024 by Police Station Dabra, District Gwalior in connection with Crime No.294/2024 registered in relation to the offences punishable u/Ss. 342, 363, 366, 376-D, 506 of IPC and Section 5/6 of Protection of Children from Sexual Offences Act.

entities.text: Protection of Children from Sexual Offences Act
entities.label: STATUTE

sentences.text: Learned Public Prosecutor for the State opposed the application and prayed for its rejection by contending that on the basis of the allegations and the material available on record, no case for grant of bail is made out.

This fourth repeat bail application has been filed on the ground of delayed trial after dismissal of the earlier applications as withdrawn vide NEUTRAL CITATION NO. 2025:MPHC-GWL:16910 2 MCRC-18034-2025 orders dated 16.07.2024, 21.09.2024 and17.03.2025 in M.Cr.C.
Nos.24382/2024, 31851/2024 and 5913/2025 respectively.

entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text:
The contents of the bail application and the documents annexed thereto indicate that there are no change of circumstances in the present case since except for filing of order sheet of trial Court dated 24.05.22025 no other proceedings had been filed, which would had been a reason for granting bail,
therefore, for the time being no case for bail is made out.
Accordingly, this fourth bail application is hereby dismissed.

(MILIND RAMESH PHADKE) JUDGE neetu Dilip Vanshkar vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 7 August, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/144792552/
